reason: The accepted team outcome is OUTCOME_A_COMPONENT with zero frozen-gate regression, zero model calls and zero owner cost, and its integration contract's drop-in path is additive and bounded (one frozen full-sentence NLCS-1 search per under-covered concept, capped at 2, emitted only for the question's own language). Adopting it is squarely the product's retrieval-first doctrine: it can only ADD candidate rows behind the existing bundle seam, never remove, re-rank or re-label one. The measured benefit is modest (one cell-level frozen-authority recovery, corporate-criminal-liability::fr 0/2 -> 1/2, with the coverage axis honestly null), so this is adopted as a cheap additive recall arm, not as a bar claim.

runtime_cost.added_searches_per_question_at_adoption: one per under-covered concept, capped at 2; 0 for a question whose retrieved set already covers all of its concepts

what_product_did.vendored_component_note: byte-identical vendored copy of the accepted frontier/frontier-concept-seed-recall/nlcs.py (accepted sha256 306873c3...); the only edit is a provenance header. The accepted branch is not merged into lab/product and the module is pure (re + unicodedata), so importing it from the mount would make the product depend on a path outside its tree.
what_product_did.wiring: live/refresh mode only; the arm plans variants from the retrieved set, issues one additive OpenCaseLaw search per variant through the accepted ocl_adapter client/transport (so the content-addressed cache and request-key derivation are the adapter's own), merges new rows under the concept_seed.nlcs channel, and records provenance. Offline/fixture mode is inert, so the frozen offline slice and every committed packet byte are unchanged.
what_product_did.additivity_guarantee: existing candidates are never removed, re-ranked or re-labelled; a failed search leaves the baseline untouched (fail-open for retrieval, fail-closed for claims).

claim_ceiling: No artifact may assert that a map helps a jurist, that any authority is absent from the corpus, that any frozen bar is met or moved, or that any packet is fit to serve. Usefulness remains the human product gate's question and admission remains fail-closed. Concept-coverage counts are lexical coverage of a retrieved set, not a legal conclusion; a zero count is a retrieval signal, not proof of corpus absence.
